text: Completed existing recording-plan support for I-DT and fixed-threshold Engbert-Kliegl: checked IdtParameters/EkParameters, RecordingMethod values, descriptors, typed parameter metadata and versioned codecs. Ten new tests on each runtime verify direct/interpreted/restored and heterogeneous registry replay, independent event-time/label expectations, axis/minimum sensitivity, exact long duration encoding, invalid inputs, typed missing/duplicate method and schema errors, irregular-sampling failures and pixel/degree compile rejection. An etaX encoder mutant was killed by two tests, restored byte-exact. Full local gates pass 2704 tests on JVM/Scala.js, zero warnings/errors, headers/format/generated workflow/boundaries and docs/tlSite; documentation coverage check passes. Public recording guide executes and states explicit calibration, no hidden fitting, synchronous execution and preflight limits. I-VT v1 fixture unchanged. Changes are local and uncommitted; no push, publication or new detector-validation claim.
